thread:
Alyssa (ENG-Platform): Quick async check — Osprey private rollout. TL;DR: staging cutover tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need network owners + PR reviews. Who's got cert rotation and NAT egress covered? @Jordan?

Jordan (NetOps): I can take egress. Working with ops to open 10.4.33.0/24 outbound via NAT gateway. Still waiting on customer egress IPs — they promised by EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sam W: I merged most infra changes. Two PRs left: infra/terraform#342 (VPC peering) and infra/helm#81 (onprem-sidecar). Both need quick reviews.

Tia L: PRs in my queue. I'll eyeball infra/terraform#342 now. Any known blocking firewall rules on customer side other than 443/8443?

Jordan (NetOps): Customer needs port 22 for image sync (airgap bootstrap) + 443 for registry. We'll also need 1194 for VPN if we use the tunnel. Confirmed with @Osprey-SRE.

Osprey-SRE: confirm — we agreed 22 and 443. VPN is optional (prefer direct peering), but we may fall back to VPN if peering fails.

Alyssa (ENG-Platform): Ok. Two action items: (1) @Jordan finalize NAT egress list and post IPs here; (2) @Tia merge PRs and tag @Sam W for rollout matrix. Also need image signing: who is on cert rotation?

Sam W: I'll handle image signing. Plan: sign artifacts and push to onprem registry. Using cosign. Example config snippet for the bootstrap job:
```yaml
bootstrap:
  registry: osprey.local:5000
  image: redwood/runtime:1.24.0
  cosign_key: /secrets/cosign.key
```
I'll add this to the runbook.

Jordan (NetOps): Posted egress IPs: 34.122.11.7, 34.122.11.8, 34.122.11.9. Please ensure customer whitelists them. Also adding a firewall rule snippet for their ops team:
`gcloud compute firewall-rules create allow-osprey-egress --direction=EGRESS --priority=1000 --destination-ranges=0.0.0.0/0 --ports=443,22 --network=ocp-network`
Ping if syntax needs tuning.

Tia L: Reviewed infra/terraform#342 — looks good aside from one variable name. Left one small comment. infra/helm#81 has liveness probe tweak request. I'll merge after CI passes.

Osprey-SRE: FYI we've scheduled artifact sync window: 02:00-03:00 PT tomorrow. If peering doesn't cut, we'll trigger VPN fallback at 02:15.

Alyssa (ENG-Platform): Great. Two last risks: airgap artifact signature verification (Sam flagged cosign trust root) and PR merge timing vs. staging cutover. Can we add a canary job to smoke the registry post-sync?

Sam W: Yep — adding a canary job to the helm chart. Will push before 22:00 PT. PR link: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/infra/merge_requests/81

Tia L: Merged infra/terraform#342 (now on main). CI passed. :tada:

Jordan (NetOps): Noted. I'll send the final IP confirmation and a checklist to ops-runbooks channel after this.

Alyssa (ENG-Platform): Thanks team — I'll compile these into the rollout doc and update the customer-facing checklist. If anything blocks, drop into #oncall immediately. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Integration deploy scheduled for 22:15 PT (canary job).
